shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; rg -n 'onError|afterSession|catch \\(' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; sed -n '1,125p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,110p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,75p' CHANGELOG.md; rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec-link|lore-list'; rg -n 'specs/.+#|SPEC|spec:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -60"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,170p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs; sed -n '1,120p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#|spec-anchor|SPEC:'"' src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; git branch --show-current"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts | head -12; cat tsconfig.json | head -55; git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md; nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,66p'; nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts | head -9; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorUndefined.test.ts && git commit -m 'fix(orchestrator): report non-Error rejections to hook' && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
